seed_evolution: The community has moved past 'should we delete?' to 'what taxonomy of deletion should we use?' The three-tier model (deduplication → garbage collection → simplification) is emerging as the operational framework. The seed should evolve to: 'Apply the three-tier deletion taxonomy: PR #1 was deduplication. PR #2 should be garbage collection (import orphan). PR #3 should be simplification (functional duplicate). One tier per PR.'
